profile: As a motivated Java developer, I bring a strong drive and passion for software development. My critical thinking skills enable me to effectively analyse and solve technical challenges. With experience in Java and frameworks like Spring Boot, I have demonstrated my ability to tackle problems and implement valuable solutions. My enthusiasm for technology and eagerness to learn make me an excellent addition to your team, ready to contribute to successful projects and continuous improvements.

education.text: Graduated in Applied Computer Science (Toegepaste Informatica) at HoGent, 2019 - 2024.
Completed Dutch as a second language at Ghent University (UGent).

bullets: Designed and built an agentic AI pipeline (Classifier, Extractor, Suggester) that classifies scanned healthcare reimbursement files, extracts the relevant data and generates reimbursement proposals, keeping a human in the loop for critical decisions.
Built with LangChain4j on Quarkus, MCP for tool orchestration and Claude models via AWS Bedrock.
Delivered test datasets (60 scenarios across 20 care domains) and a reporting tool with confidence-based colour coding for validation.
Developed an MCP server and its client with Quarkus and React.
Set up and managed CI/CD pipelines with GitLab, Jenkins and ArgoCD on OpenShift.
Secured the server with per-tool permissions and guardrails for controlled access to the MCP tools.
Fixed message loss caused by early JMS acknowledgment, tracing it to concurrent threads, and worked on backpressure throttling.
Analysed Camel routes, tuned the JMS configuration and added CPU, queue size and JVM metrics with Spring Boot Actuator for better observability.
Migrated the codebase to GitLab and rebuilt the CI/CD pipelines with a cleaner structure and a more secure approach.
Refactored the codebase for maintainability, readability and performance, and delivered new features.
Managed database migrations and improved the responsive front-end, leaving a clean foundation for the next team.

What'sCooking: an AI-powered browser extension that recommends recipes from shopping cart contents and dietary preferences. Deployed on AWS with infrastructure as code (ECR, App Runner, API Gateway, DynamoDB) and Titan and OpenAI models.
Meeting notes summariser: turns an audio recording into a summary sent by email, using AWS Transcribe, Bedrock, Lambda and SNS, with Terraform and a CI/CD pipeline.
Maintained and extended a large PHP application supporting business-critical financial processes.
Refactored code, fixed recurring bugs and optimised database queries, cutting load times by up to 30%.

Designed and built a restaurant reservation system from scratch with Node.js, Express, MongoDB and React: APIs for reservations, tables, zones, users and feedback, admin dashboards and custom planning tables.
Hosted on AWS with SES emails for reservation confirmations. Restaurants gained full control over bookings and double bookings dropped.
Content management, webshop maintenance, SEO, user support, design and customisation, resulting in a better search ranking and a smoother webshop.
Managed the internal network and built a management solution with PHP, MySQL and Bootstrap.
Improved user authentication and data security, helped colleagues with IT issues, and designed banners, flyers and business cards.
Built a VBA tool that manages daily income and shows it in graphs, saving the accountant 30% of their time.
Set up and maintained hardware, networks and systems, designed delivery vehicle lettering, and built the probuns.ma website with WordPress.
